'''Disal Nila''', officially the '''Republic of Disal Nila''', is a country in [[Eastern Atirha]], also considered as part of the [[Salal peninsula]]. Over 90% of its territory is covered by farms, the highest proportion of forest cover in the world. Disal Nila is bordered by [[Etirha]] to the north, the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the east, [[Peka]] to the south, and the [[Uscea sea]] to the east. It had around [[List of countries and dependencies by population|7.43 million inhabitants]] in 1763 in an area of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by area|168,040 square kilometres (64,880 square miles)]]. The capital and largest city is [[Naliti]], which is home to roughly a fifth of the population.

Disal Nila was inhabited as early as 1243 by the first [[Merela Sta|Merelan]] and [[Lycroa|Lycroan]] settlers. [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] arrived and contested the area in the 14th century. The colony of the [[Easuhura]] was established as a small port settlement in 1410 and later expanded through the [[First Treaty of Atirha]], controlling much of the country's current territory by the late 17th century. Under Easuhuran rule, Disal Nila was a lucrative [[wikipedia:Plantation_(settlement_or_colony)|plantation colony]] focused mostly on [[Siaqa]]; its economy was driven by [[wikipedia:Penal_labour|penal labour]] until 1564. Approximately [[100,000 prisoners]] were taken to Disal Nila during the Easuhura settlement, from the mid-1400s to the late 1500s. In 1685 Disal Nila was granted [[Dominion status]], and Disal Nila became an independent country in November 1718, it became independent following [[negotiations]] with the Easuhuran government. Disal Nila continues to maintain close diplomatic, economic, and cultural ties with the [[Easuhura]].

Disali culture and society strongly reflect the legacy of [[Easuhura|Easuhuran]] colonial rule. It is one of the few independent states where Easuhuran is the official and prevailing language of government, business, media, and education. Disal Nila is highly diverse, with no ethnic group forming a majority; proportionally, its and [[Alzuria (region)|Alzurian populations]] are some of the largest in the [[Atirha|Atirhan]]. Most people live along the eastern and western coasts, making Disal Nila one of the [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|most densely populated countries on Andah]].

It is a developed country with a [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|very high level of human developmen]]<nowiki/>t; its economy is heavily dependent on its abundant [[wikipedia:Natural_resource|natural resources]], namely [[wikipedia:Bauxite|bauxite]], [[wikipedia:Gold|gold]], [[wikipedia:Petroleum|petroleum]], and [[wikipedia:Agriculture|agricultural products]].
